Actor Swara Bhasker faces backlash over remarks on 'Jauhar'

Actor Swara Bhasker has drawn criticism and faced multiple complaints for her remarks on the 'Jauhar' ritual, as depicted in the film 'Padmaavat'. Several Rajput organizations and individuals have expressed outrage, demanding legal action and FIRs against her. Minister Raghuraj Singh stated that women like Bhasker are a curse on Hindutva and culture. Katha Vachak Aniruddhaacharya responded to Bhasker's comments, describing 'Jauhar' as a protection of sacred character. Complaints have been filed in various locations, including Muzaffarnagar and Hathras, with demands for impartial investigation and action.
